name: NEUROVORE: Illegal Combat Reflex Mod
subcategory: underground / illegal combat sim / BCI mod
description: A black-market BCI modification suite that grafts onto licensed combat games and strips all safety governors, enabling full-pain feedback, neural fatigue accumulation, and 'bleed-through' — a state where combat stress responses persist in the player's nervous system after disconnection. NEUROVORE tournaments are held in rotating underground venues across Tier 1-2, with participants betting Φ on matches that can leave winners and losers alike shaking for days. The mod's development is attributed to a programmer collective known only as the Marrow Guild.
story_hooks: A Meridian NHB investigator goes undercover in the NEUROVORE circuit and begins to understand why participants choose this — and loses their professional objectivity.

The Marrow Guild approaches a legitimate game developer with an offer: incorporate NEUROVORE's core architecture into a legal product, or they'll expose that the developer's own safety governors are already compromised.
Tassilo Obi-Ferreira's surviving sibling enters the NEUROVORE circuit to find out if their brother's death was truly an accident.
